visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Number of Digits Is Hard-Coded
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 9474 is an Armstrong number with 4 digits, but the program says false for it.

solution.explanation: The exponent is the number of digits of n, not always 3. With digits fixed at 3, a four-digit number is compared against the wrong sum. Compute the length from the number itself.
